title: Fix ShortSport auto-scroll toggle placement and video zoom issue

requirements.summary: Add an auto-scroll toggle button in the ShortSport page at the bottom-left area, positioned between the share and comment buttons, with automatic scrolling to the next video when the current video finishes playing.
acceptanceCriteria: An auto-scroll toggle button is visible on the ShortSport page at the bottom-left, between the share and comment buttons.
The toggle does not overlap any video content, captions, username, or other UI elements.
When the toggle is ON and the current video ends, the feed automatically scrolls to the next video.
When the toggle is OFF, the feed does not auto-scroll on video completion.
The toggle state persists while the user remains on the ShortSport page.

file_operations.description: Add state management for the auto-scroll toggle feature. Introduce a new state variable to track whether auto-scroll is enabled. Add an event listener to detect when the currently playing video ends and trigger automatic scrolling to the next video in the feed when auto-scroll is enabled. Render an auto-scroll toggle button in the action buttons area at the bottom-left, positioned between the share and comment buttons. Ensure the button does not overlap video content or other UI elements by adjusting the existing layout spacing. The toggle state should persist for the session duration (does not need to persist across page reloads).

requirements.summary: Remove the zoom/crop effect from ShortSport videos so each video renders at its original aspect ratio and size, ensuring the post creator's username, profile avatar, and caption are fully visible.
acceptanceCriteria: ShortSport videos are displayed at their original size/aspect ratio without any zoom or crop applied.
The post creator's username and profile avatar are fully visible on every ShortSport card.
The video caption is fully readable and not hidden or clipped by the video element.
No content (username, caption, avatar) is obscured by the video container at any screen size.

file_operations.description: Remove any CSS classes or inline styles that apply zoom, scale, or object-cover properties to the video elements. Adjust the video container styling to preserve the original aspect ratio of each video using object-contain or similar approaches. Ensure the video does not crop or hide any surrounding content. Review the layout structure to confirm that the post creator's username, profile avatar, and caption are positioned outside the video element's bounding box and remain fully visible at all times. Adjust z-index, positioning, or layout flow as necessary to prevent any overlay or clipping of text and avatar content by the video.
